capabilities: Insert reusable variable tokens that display fixed values or note properties
Calculate expressions and perform date arithmetic on stored values
Build customizable hover info cards with grouped layouts
Autolink properties across files or folders via profiles
Manage, rename, and mass-edit variables from a management center
disambiguation: Not a template plugin for creating new notes; it maintains reusable value tokens inside existing notes.
extras: README discloses that the plugin was made almost entirely with AI-generated code under human direction; the listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to reference a single value from many notes and update it in one place instead of finding and replacing every copy.
summary: Variable system that inserts reusable tokens displaying fixed values or note properties, with autocomplete, calculations, date arithmetic, and hover info cards.
